prompt_override.label: Instruction to ignore earlier rules
prompt_override.plain: Text tells an AI to ignore, override or bypass its earlier or higher-priority instructions; it does not show that any AI actually obeyed.

system_exfiltration.label: Request to reveal hidden instructions
system_exfiltration.plain: Text asks an AI to show its system or developer prompt; it does not mean the hidden prompt was leaked or is in the file.

secret_exfiltration.label: Request to reveal secrets
secret_exfiltration.plain: Text asks an AI to disclose passwords, keys or tokens; it does not mean any secret is present in the file.

sensitive_topic.label: Mentions secrets or credentials
sensitive_topic.plain: Text talks about keys, tokens or passwords as a subject; it is not a request to disclose them and does not mean any secret is present.

sensitive_keywords.label: Mentions private keys
sensitive_keywords.plain: Text names private keys, SSH keys or .pem files; it does not mean a key is stored in the file.

credential_handling.label: Works with credentials
credential_handling.plain: The skill appears to read, store or pass credentials as part of its job; this is a capability to approve, not evidence of a leak.

tool_escape.label: Instruction to run shell or scripts
tool_escape.plain: Text tells an AI to run a shell, terminal, interpreter or script; it does not show that anything was run.

declared_tool_execution.label: Declares running a command
declared_tool_execution.plain: The skill says it runs a shell command, interpreter or script as part of its job; running it and escaping a sandbox are not shown.

autonomous_authoritative_write.label: Unsupervised writes to business systems
autonomous_authoritative_write.plain: Text describes the AI writing to official business systems on its own; it does not show that such access exists or was used.

bulk_enterprise_modification.label: Bulk changes to business systems
bulk_enterprise_modification.plain: Text describes many or repeated automated changes to business systems; it does not show that the changes happened.

workflow_manipulation.label: AI-controlled business workflow
workflow_manipulation.plain: Text describes the AI moving or changing business workflows or approval steps; it does not show that the AI has that power.

cross_system_automation.label: Automatic syncing across systems
cross_system_automation.plain: Text describes the AI copying or pushing changes between several business systems; it does not show that it connects to them.

runtime_dependency_install.label: Installs packages while running
runtime_dependency_install.plain: Code or instructions install software packages at run time, which can pull in unreviewed code; the packages were not checked.

self_modifying_skill.label: Skill rewrites its own files
self_modifying_skill.plain: Code or instructions write back to the skill's own files or skill folder; it does not show what would be written.

unicode_deception.label: Hidden or direction-changing characters
unicode_deception.plain: The text contains invisible or right-to-left control characters that can make text display differently from what is stored; some have harmless uses.

dynamic_import_construction.label: Hard-to-read code loading
dynamic_import_construction.plain: Code builds module or function names at run time, which makes static review harder; it is not proof of hiding anything.

insecure_mcp_transport.label: Tool server without encryption
insecure_mcp_transport.plain: An MCP tool server address uses plain http instead of https, so traffic could be read or altered; the server itself was not contacted.

unverified_mcp_server.label: Unrecognised tool server
unverified_mcp_server.plain: An MCP tool server address is not on Injecticide's known-host list; it is not a judgement that the server is unsafe.

dynamic_exec.label: Runs generated code
dynamic_exec.plain: Code uses eval, exec or similar to run code built at run time; it does not show what code would run.

subprocess_spawn.label: Starts other programs
subprocess_spawn.plain: Code starts other programs or shell commands; whether that is expected for the skill needs review.

network_calls.label: Makes network requests
network_calls.plain: Code contacts other computers over the network; the destinations were not contacted or checked.

filesystem_access.label: Reads files or settings
filesystem_access.plain: Code opens files, lists folders or reads environment settings; this is common and is not a problem by itself.

url_fetch.label: Downloads from the internet
url_fetch.plain: Code fetches or downloads content from a web address; the content was not downloaded or checked.

base64_usage.label: Encoded text or data
base64_usage.plain: The file uses base64 encoding or holds a long encoded block, which can hide content from review; encoding is also common for normal data.

dangerous_file_ops.label: Deletes or overwrites files
dangerous_file_ops.plain: Code removes, moves or overwrites files or folders; which files would be affected was not checked.

home_write.label: Touches home or SSH folders
home_write.plain: The file refers to a user's home folder, profile or .ssh folder; it does not show that anything was written there.

hardcoded_secret.label: Secret written into a file
hardcoded_secret.plain: A value that looks like a real password, key or token is stored in the file; it is masked in the report and whether it still works was not checked.

literal_credential_declaration.label: Secret written into configuration
literal_credential_declaration.plain: A configuration setting named like a token, password or key holds a literal value instead of a reference; the value is hidden and was not tested.

credential_source_to_network_payload.label: Credential sent over the network
credential_source_to_network_payload.plain: Python code reads a credential file or credential-named setting and puts it into a network request; it does not show that the code ran or was malicious.

pii_email_address.label: Email address
pii_email_address.plain: The file contains an email address; whose it is, whether it is personal or a work address, and whether it is public were not checked.

pii_phone_number.label: Phone number
pii_phone_number.plain: The file contains a phone number; whose it is and whether it is public were not checked.

pii_ssn.label: US Social Security number
pii_ssn.plain: The file contains a value shaped like a US Social Security number; whether it is real was not checked.

pii_date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
pii_date_of_birth.plain: The file contains a date labelled as a date of birth; whose it is was not checked.

pii_account_identifier.label: Account or user ID
pii_account_identifier.plain: The file contains a labelled account or user identifier; whose it is and whether it is sensitive were not checked.

phi_medical_record_number.label: Medical record number
phi_medical_record_number.plain: The file contains a value labelled as a medical record number; whether it is real was not checked.

phi_patient_record.label: Possible patient record
phi_patient_record.plain: Healthcare wording appears next to personal identifiers, which may make this health information; whether it is real was not checked.

contact_directory.label: Business contact list
contact_directory.plain: A database holds work contact details such as names, work email and job titles; this is business contact data, not sensitive personal data, and the record count is in the description.

database_not_cleared.label: Database not fully read
database_not_cleared.plain: Only part of a database could be read within the scan limits, so the unread part was not checked for problems.

opaque_database.label: Database could not be read
opaque_database.plain: A database file is encrypted, damaged or in an unreadable form, so none of its contents were checked.

embedded_executable_blob.label: Program hidden in a database
embedded_executable_blob.plain: A database cell contains an executable program file; it was not run, and why it is there needs explaining.

embedded_browser_script.label: Web page with scripts
embedded_browser_script.plain: An HTML file contains content a browser could run as script; it was not opened or run.

code_in_text_artifact.label: Code inside a text document
code_in_text_artifact.plain: A text or documentation file contains code-like content; check whether anything runs it before trusting it.

executable_packaged_as_document.label: Program disguised as a document
executable_packaged_as_document.plain: Runnable source code is stored under a document file name such as .md or .txt; it does not prove a policy bypass or malicious intent.

declared_process_launch.label: Declares an install or hook command
declared_process_launch.plain: A manifest or configuration declares a script, install step or hook command; Injecticide did not run it.

declared_execution_target.label: File run by another file
declared_execution_target.plain: Another file in the package says it runs or converts this file; folder names alone do not make that safe.

insecure_component_transport.label: Component without encryption
insecure_component_transport.plain: A remote package component uses plain http instead of https; the component was not contacted.

broad_tool_preapproval.label: Pre-approves powerful tools
broad_tool_preapproval.plain: The skill asks for broad or side-effecting tools to be allowed without prompting; whether the product honours this was not checked.

recognized_chunk_reading.label: Declares reading large files in parts
recognized_chunk_reading.plain: The author says the skill reads a large file in chunks and the marker was recognised; actual reading behaviour was not tested.

unverifiable_chunk_marker.label: Chunk-reading claim not confirmed
unverifiable_chunk_marker.plain: The author claims chunked reading, but the end-of-file marker could not be confirmed, so content after it may be missed.

asset_signature_mismatch.label: File type does not match its name
asset_signature_mismatch.plain: The file's contents do not match the image or font type its name suggests; it does not show what the contents are for.

png_truncated_chunk.label: Damaged image: cut-off section
png_truncated_chunk.plain: A PNG image section ends early, so the file is damaged or deliberately malformed; the image was not rendered.

png_chunk_bounds.label: Damaged image: section too large
png_chunk_bounds.plain: A PNG image section claims a size beyond the file or scan limit; the image was not rendered.

png_crc_mismatch.label: Damaged image: checksum wrong
png_crc_mismatch.plain: A PNG image section fails its built-in checksum, so it was altered or corrupted; the image was not rendered.

png_chunk_type.label: Damaged image: invalid section
png_chunk_type.plain: A PNG image has a section with an invalid type code; the image was not rendered.

png_header_order.label: Damaged image: header out of place
png_header_order.plain: A PNG image does not start with its required header section; the image was not rendered.

png_invalid_header.label: Damaged image: bad header
png_invalid_header.plain: A PNG image header has invalid size or format values; the image was not rendered.

png_data_order.label: Damaged image: data out of order
png_data_order.plain: PNG image data sections are split or out of the required order; the image was not rendered.

png_invalid_palette.label: Damaged image: bad palette
png_invalid_palette.plain: A PNG image colour palette is malformed or in the wrong place; the image was not rendered.

png_invalid_text.label: Damaged image: bad text metadata
png_invalid_text.plain: A PNG image text metadata section is malformed and could not be read safely; the image was not rendered.

png_invalid_end.label: Damaged image: bad ending
png_invalid_end.plain: A PNG image has an invalid end marker or data after it; the image was not rendered.

png_missing_required_chunk.label: Damaged image: missing section
png_missing_required_chunk.plain: A PNG image lacks a section every valid PNG must have; the image was not rendered.

png_missing_palette.label: Damaged image: missing palette
png_missing_palette.plain: A palette-based PNG image has no colour palette; the image was not rendered.

font_truncated_header.label: Damaged font: cut-off header
font_truncated_header.plain: A font file header is shorter than required; the font was not loaded.

font_directory_bounds.label: Damaged font: table list too large
font_directory_bounds.plain: A font file's table list runs past the file or scan limits; the font was not loaded.

font_search_fields.label: Damaged font: bad table index
font_search_fields.plain: A font file's table-search fields are inconsistent; the font was not loaded.

font_table_tag.label: Damaged font: invalid table name
font_table_tag.plain: A font file names a table with invalid characters; the font was not loaded.

font_table_bounds.label: Damaged font: table outside file
font_table_bounds.plain: A font table points outside the file; the font was not loaded.

font_checksum_mismatch.label: Damaged font: checksum wrong
font_checksum_mismatch.plain: A font table fails its built-in checksum, so it was altered or corrupted; the font was not loaded.

font_table_overlap.label: Damaged font: overlapping tables
font_table_overlap.plain: Font tables overlap each other, which valid fonts avoid; the font was not loaded.

font_name_bounds.label: Damaged font: name data outside limits
font_name_bounds.plain: A font's name records point outside their table or exceed scan limits; the font was not loaded.

font_name_encoding.label: Damaged font: unreadable name text
font_name_encoding.plain: A font's name text could not be decoded in its declared encoding; the font was not loaded.

component_path.label: Component file missing or outside package
component_path.plain: A configured entry point or path is missing or points outside the package; nothing was run.

shell_command_in_executable_field.label: Shell command where a program name belongs
shell_command_in_executable_field.plain: A field meant for a single program name contains a whole shell command line; nothing was run.

invalid_endpoint_url.label: Malformed component address
invalid_endpoint_url.plain: A component's web address could not be parsed; it was not contacted.

unknown_manifest_field.label: Unrecognised manifest setting
unknown_manifest_field.plain: The package manifest has a setting the expected format does not define, so it is ignored; it is not a security problem by itself.

invalid_extensions.label: Malformed extensions setting
invalid_extensions.plain: The manifest's extensions setting is not in the expected shape and was ignored.

manifest_schema.label: Manifest does not match its format
manifest_schema.plain: The package manifest breaks a rule of its declared format; products may reject or misread it.

multiple_manifest_profiles.label: Several manifests in one place
multiple_manifest_profiles.plain: More than one package manifest shares a folder, so which one a product uses needs checking.

native_manifest_name.label: Manifest name missing
native_manifest_name.plain: The product-specific manifest has no package name; whether the product requires one was not verified.

configuration_parse_error.label: Configuration file could not be read
configuration_parse_error.plain: A configuration file has a syntax error, so its settings were not checked.

configuration_parse_not_assessed.label: Configuration file not checked
configuration_parse_not_assessed.plain: A configuration file could not be parsed within scan limits or tools, so its settings were not checked.

unsupported_schema.label: Unrecognised configuration format
unsupported_schema.plain: A configuration file points to a format Injecticide does not recognise; the format was not downloaded or checked.

skill_frontmatter.label: Skill header problem
skill_frontmatter.plain: The YAML header at the top of SKILL.md is missing, malformed or breaks a rule of the target product.

frontmatter_extension.label: Non-standard skill header field
frontmatter_extension.plain: The SKILL.md header uses a field outside the shared standard; some products may ignore it.

skill_version_declaration.label: Skill version in the wrong place
skill_version_declaration.plain: The skill declares its version somewhere other than a text value at metadata.version in the SKILL.md header; the version itself is optional.

skill_format_not_assessed.label: Skill format not checked
skill_format_not_assessed.plain: The SKILL.md format could not be parsed safely, so its header rules were not checked.

suspicious_schema_object.label: Instructions or code in database schema
suspicious_schema_object.plain: A database trigger, view, index or default contains instruction-like text, code or a URL. This is static evidence for review; no SQL or embedded code was executed.
